findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "translation_context" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Everything PaydaDosh knows that is relevant to translating a phrase or answering a question about Ingush — the same material the site's own assistant reads befo…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_examples · Public sink: check_ingush_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_examples · Public sink: check_ingush_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
